heading: Explore eight capabilities with synthetic evidence

sources.title: Fictional Riverbend project brief
sources.text: Riverbend is a fictional water-access project. A draft budget of GBP 42000 and a six-month delivery schedule exist. No safeguarding evidence is supplied in this fixture.

sources.title: Illustrative approval procedure
sources.text: Example only: require a named owner, passing checks, and an independent reviewer. Private-data releases additionally require a data-access review. Tool advice cannot grant approval or publish a release.

sources.title: Fictional service maintenance log
sources.text: Brand guidance version change awaits compatibility review (high). Growth dependency patch awaits tests (medium). Example hub description typo awaits review (low). No automatic production modifications.

sources.title: Illustrative onboarding guide
sources.text: Staff: learn approved capability scope, run a synthetic example, inspect sources. Contributors: clone source, use fixtures, run tests, submit a pull request. Reviewers: inspect exact-version evidence, check permissions, record an independent decision. Access is granted by an administrator.

sources.title: Illustrative developer checklist
sources.text: MCP packages require a manifest, strict input validation, cited sources, contract tests, no secrets in source, and fail-closed private HTTP authentication. A checked self-assessment is not a code audit.

sources.title: Fictional pilot retrospective
sources.text: Reporting pilot: a shared metric definition prevented CRM-created dates being counted as first gifts. Maintenance pilot: pinned guidance exposed a breaking template change before release. Onboarding pilot: a synthetic example helped contributors reproduce results. These are fictional observations, not measured organisational outcomes.

maintenance.action: Review guidance compatibility and run report regression tests before adopting the new version.
Test the dependency patch in an isolated branch before review.
Correct description and review source changes.
